created_by: assurance orchestrator (Claude Code session), acting under FedMAQ/fedmaq-experiments#75
purpose: Immutable, content-hashed record binding one pipeline candidate across the experiment, literature and manuscript repositories, with fail-closed gate states. Specification is #74; execution is #75. This record is evidence of pipeline readiness only; it is not evidence freeze and it is not results freeze.

content_hash.recipe: sha256 over json.dumps(envelope, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), default=str).encode('utf-8'), with content_hash.value set to null. Identical to src/fedmaq/core/run_identity.py:config_sha256, so the envelope and the run-identity digests share one convention rather than two that can disagree.

fedmaq-experiments.role: pipeline implementation, configuration, dispatch, tests, golden harness
fedmaq-experiments.binding_note: A binding, not an event log: this field tracks candidate.revision and moves with every re-pin. Contrast runtime_provenance.executed_revision and golden_harness.harness_revision, which are historical records of gate-0's execution and capture events and are not updated on re-pin.

fedmaq-literature.role: source-paper material against which paper-derived contracts are checked

fedmaq-manuscript.role: reported method, metric and claim surface

references.note: Referenced, not bound. #74 excludes fedmaq-analyses from pipeline-readiness evidence by declaration; its dated audit records are assurance-record references, and only the narrow producer-consumer compatibility attestation at gate 5 crosses the boundary. Listing it in revision_vector would imply a binding this envelope exists to deny.

candidate.pin_semantics: A named commit, not a follow-the-branch relation. main advancing does not move the pin, and every gate runs at the pin.

re_pin_attestation.attestation: No path in the 6783a30..d804b7f delta falls inside docs/freeze/source_manifest.json scope.include. Both commits are envelope/gate-evidence artifacts only (gate 0's envelope creation, gate 1's PASS disposition and evidence file) - no protocol, configuration, source code or claims-bearing content changed. behavioral_content_commit is therefore unchanged from the prior pin. Recorded, not inferred from the diff being small. This is gate 2's final re-pin: the candidate-freeze window opens from here per invalidation_matrix.candidate_freeze_window.
re_pin_attestation.not_licensed_by_this_attestation: Reuse of any evidence from gate 3 onward as already produced. Every gate from here runs fresh against this pin; only gates 0 and 1 are carried forward, and only because this attestation says so explicitly.

baseline.relation: direct parent of the candidate behavioral content commit 5617bf0
baseline.purpose: golden capture/compare baseline; recorded separately so the compare cannot become a self-comparison

freeze_certificate.verified_by: just freeze, user-run 2026-08-29 at 6783a30; currency at the d804b7f re-pin relies on scripts/check_freeze.py --check passing within the gate-2 just check run (assurance orchestrator, 2026-08-29), licensed because the 6783a30..d804b7f delta touches no scope.include path (gate-2 re-pin attestation).
freeze_certificate.relation_to_envelope: Distinct artifacts. The certificate is an architecture hash over scope.include paths and is one input to one gate. The envelope is this record.

runtime_provenance.external_evidence_directory: ~/fedmaq-golden-73-EVIDENCE/ (prior, #73). Gate 6 writes a new directory pinned to this envelope; prior evidence is preserved, never overwritten.
runtime_provenance.bounded: Per #74, provenance is bounded to executed revision, runtime version, dependency-lock identity, clean-tree result and evidence locations. Irrelevant host-package differences do not invalidate a gate.

golden_harness.expected_algorithm_set: pinned at gate 6 from docs/freeze/expected_runs.json; nine algorithms, as in the #73 capture
golden_harness.ignored_fields: wall-clock columns only, predeclared; a changed ignore rule is itself a golden-gate invalidation
golden_harness.allowed_difference_rule: none outside the predeclared ignored fields; the compare must end with the success marker
golden_harness.dispatch: user-run on JupyterHub from paste-ready exact-commit commands; agents do not dispatch GPU experiments

scope_boundary.in_scope: fedmaq-experiments, fedmaq-literature and fedmaq-manuscript, covering all compared algorithms plus FedMAQ, source fidelity, configuration/protocol, telemetry, provenance, manuscript claims, and simulation-lifecycle invariants affected by architecture pass 3.

out_of_scope_by_declaration.surface: fedmaq-manuscript chapter_3.tex sec:theo_bounds_quant - the eps = min(d/s^2, sqrt(d)/s) bound, the Tier-2 rationale, and the sum_k p_k^2 argument
out_of_scope_by_declaration.basis: A formal re-derivation against the shipped l-infinity error-feedback operator is not a routine repair. ADR-0019 Consequences records it open with an explicit instruction not to infer a verdict. The gate reads PASS within a boundary that names what it did not check, instead of PASS over a known mismatch.

out_of_scope_by_declaration.surface: fedmaq-journal-article paper.tex front matter and sections/**
out_of_scope_by_declaration.basis: Outside pipeline-readiness evidence; #41 carries the site inventory and the author freeze-historically disposition.
Swept but not read in full by pass 22. Living-log work, not a pipeline-readiness contract.
Not audited at all by pass 22. docs/freeze/** is gate input - its integrity is checked by the freeze certificate and the golden gate, not by prose audit.
Already excluded as pipeline evidence by #74 Implementation Decisions; restated here so the boundary is one list.

scope_boundary.boundary_is_invalidating: A change to this boundary is itself a gate invalidation. Any gate reaching PASS must record this boundary verbatim in its evidence.

gates.name: Envelope creation and candidate attestation
gates.notes: This record is the gate 0 evidence.

gates.name: Literature/protocol audit
mandatory_evidence: source-grounded findings across the three bound repositories
the carried-forward verdict list with its basis
no unresolved static mismatch inside the boundary
gates.notes: Framed as a delta audit, not a from-zero sweep, and the framing is recorded rather than left to omission. Anchor is 530f8ae (2026-08-26), the fedmaq-experiments state contemporaneous with the baseline implementation audit 7cb6154 in fedmaq-analyses. Delta 530f8ae..6783a30 is 46 commits, 32 of which touch behavior-bearing paths. The audit covers that delta plus re-verification of every prior verdict the delta could have disturbed: architecture passes #46/#53/#73 (pass 3 decomposed the simulation lifecycle), the #24/#25/#26 quantizer and byte-accounting seam, #34 power-mean reformulation, and the surfaces #11 pass 22 recorded as unreached. A prior verdict may be carried forward only if the gate 1 evidence names it and states the basis; silence is not carry-forward. A fresh #11 pass is the manuscript arm of this gate - #11 is Living/Recurring and is not closed here.

gates.name: Repair and bounded re-audit
mandatory_evidence: confirmation that repairs altered no unapproved method contract
gates.notes: Routine repairs only, classified by effect. Method changes, source-fidelity trade-offs, frozen-configuration changes and result interpretation escalate to the thesis author. The candidate-freeze window opens at the final re-pin of this gate. Gate 1 left zero open findings requiring repair, so this gate's re-audit is a re-pin plus a documented disposition of the two already-dispositioned gate-1 findings, not a fresh repair pass. Candidate re-pinned to d804b7f; the candidate-freeze window is now open.

gate_state_semantics.PASS: all mandatory evidence for that gate is present, current, internally consistent, and bound to this envelope
gate_state_semantics.BLOCKED: required evidence is missing or unavailable
gate_state_semantics.INVALIDATED: evidence made stale by a dependency change
gate_state_semantics.fail_closed: Missing, failed, conflicting, stale or provenance-incomplete evidence is never an implicit PASS.
gate_state_semantics.transitions: Only the responsible verifier may transition an individual gate. Only the thesis author may declare the pipeline frozen.

invalidation_matrix.source: FedMAQ/fedmaq-experiments#74, Implementation Decisions, plus amendment 2026-08-29 sections 1 and 2
invalidation_matrix.demonstration_required: #75 acceptance requires the matrix be demonstrated, not asserted: representative changes to behavior, configuration, protocol claims, manuscript wording, harness rules, runtime provenance, evidence references and the scope boundary must each invalidate exactly the gates #74 names, with the demonstration recorded as envelope evidence.
invalidation_matrix.candidate_freeze_window: After the gate 2 final re-pin and before gate 7 completes: a commit inside scope.include, or touching claims-bearing content in fedmaq-literature or fedmaq-manuscript, INVALIDATES every gate already passed, and the mechanical-repair clause is unavailable. A commit whose entire content is envelope or gate-evidence artifacts does not invalidate - it is the output of the gates, not drift in what the gates examined.

freeze_states.pipeline_freeze: requires gates 0-7. Licenses dispatch of #22 beginning at step 1. Not clearance for #22 step 6 while #45 is open.
freeze_states.evidence_freeze: additionally requires the prescribed campaign artifacts with provenance and ingestion.
freeze_states.declared_by: the thesis author only, explicitly. Nothing in this envelope declares a freeze.
